nodes.text: @outbreakupdates 🤷‍♂️ hMPV, nothing special, it’s winter ! Globally, ~800 million get it every year, 7-10 days recovery if in good health, 2-3 weeks if in poor health, young, old. Very low fatality incidence. Cough may linger a bit for those in poor general health. Good levels of Vit D may help.
